selection_rule: Midpoint of the 3.0..3.25 mV bracket shared by both tested preceding decision signs; freeze before this new sequence is evaluated
acceptance: Every cycle must satisfy existing logical polarity, full 16..20 ns hold, receiver, reset and strict waveform voltage checks. Report decision-only results separately; they cannot override a failed voltage check.
boundary: Ideal differential stimulus correction in one simulated mismatch realization, not a physical trim circuit, unseen-device validation, qualified converter or workload evaluation. Terminal model-range qualification remains open. Failed v1 is retained.
